events.verdict: Harris (DET) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Haliburton (IND) after the release of the jump shot attempt. Haliburton extends his leg to create the marginal contact with Harris during his follow-through thereafter.
Cunningham (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Duren (DET) initiates contact with Mathurin's (IND) arm, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Haliburton (IND) initiates contact with Beasley's (DET) right arm and side, affecting his ability to receive the pass.
Duren (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Turner (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Beasley (DET) shifts his position as he completes the hand-off, but he avoids delivering contact or extending into Nembhard's (IND) path.
Ivey (DET) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Nembhard (IND) near midcourt.
Nembhard (IND) delivers contact to Ivey (DET) that dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position.
Turner (IND) initiates contact to Duren's (DET) wrist during the contest, affecting his layup attempt.
Duren (DET) and Siakam (IND) engage and disengage with one another as they each attempt to establish rebounding position.
Mathurin (IND) avoids making any illegal contact with Ivey (DET) during his putback shot attempt.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Beasley (DET) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Sheppard (IND) is moving alongside of Beasley (DET) on the perimeter and the body contact is marginal.
